title: Return several records
summary: Spring Boot: Return several records. Add a third title.
introduction: A list becomes a JSON array. Open GET /books. Read the example, then check the result.
learningObjectives: Return several records with Spring Boot

blocks.text: Install Java 17 or later and JBang. Save one example as Lesson.java and run jbang Lesson.java. JBang downloads the dependency on the //DEPS line. Use http://127.0.0.1:8080 and stop the server before another example.

blocks.title: Return several records

blocks.text: The two list items become two JSON array entries in their original order.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: List.of makes a list that cannot be changed in place.
